# An Honest Absence

The first entry in the reformed Archive records an intentional absence. Ilyra returns the vault key, Mara accepts accountable custody, and Nessa invents a catalog reference that certifies without locating.

The turn list is canonical verbatim provenance. Recollections remain character-owned interpretations.
